title: Improved FKN approximation
statement: Let $C\ge1$ and suppose that for every positive integer $m$, every Boolean function $g\colon\{\pm1\}^m\to\{\pm1\}$, and every $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$ with $0\le\varepsilon$ and $1-\varepsilon\ge0$, if the level-one Fourier weight of $g$ is at least $1-\varepsilon$, then some signed dictator on $m$ coordinates differs from $g$ on at most a fraction $C\varepsilon$ of inputs. Now let $n$ be a positive integer and let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ satisfy $0\le\delta$, $1-\delta\ge0$, and level-one Fourier weight at least $1-\delta$. Then some signed dictator differs from $f$ on at most a fraction $\delta/4+16C^2\delta^2\max\{\log_2(1/(C\delta)),1\}$ of inputs.
